20512: A squid girl who claims to be "A Messenger of the Sea". Frustrated about her ocean being polluted by human beings, she planned to conquer the world to exact revenge on humanity.
34653: A girl who works at the Lemon Beach House alongside her older sister. After Ika fails to invade the surface, she forces them to work for her to pay off a part of the wall she destroyed. She is the younger sister to Chizuru Aizawa and older sister to Takeru Aizawa.
34654: Chizuru is the proud owner and manager of the Lemon Beach House. She is Eiko Aizawa and Takeru Aizawa's eldest sister. Unlike her sister, Chizuru is much calmer and cares more for Ika.
34655: Goro Arashiyama is a lifeguard at the local beach, and an old friend of the Aizawa siblings. As a self-proclaimed "Protector of the Sea", he has a mutual respect for Ika, despite seeing her as a hassle. He has a strong crush on Chizuru that she seems to not be aware of.
34656: Sanae is Eiko Aizawa's childhood friend and classmate, and is completely infatuated with Ika Musume. Sanae has an obsessive crush over Ika Musume, much to their dismay.
37242: Eiko and Chizuru's little brother, who enjoys playing with Ika. Compared to his sisters, Takeru acts very childish and carefree, and actually goes out of his way to befriend Ika.
37243: An extraterrestrial researcher from the United States who believes Ika to be an alien and wishes to take her back with her for research.
37244: A surf-loving girl who starts working at the Lemon Beach House. She has an older sister, Aiko Saitou. Unlike everyone else, she sees Ika as an actual threat to humanity, and is genuinely afraid of her.
38185: The daughter of the owner of a rival beach house.
38746: A middle schoolgirl who Ika makes friends with after a prank gone wrong. She is the first person who Ika makes friends with and they soon become best friends. She is also on a baseball team.
40730: A friend of Takeru's that appears various times throughout the series.
41147: A gentle girl with a peaceful aura, who sometimes talks with Ika, hinting that invading might not be the best thing to do as not all humans are bad.
49587: The owner of a rival beach house and the father of Ayumu Tokita. He's a strong, competitive man who often tries to take advantage of Ika Musume's popularity to gain support for his own beach house.
53811: Sanae's pet dog. Dislikes Squid Girl since Sanae loves her more.
